name: zero-downtime-factory
description: Integration-first scaffold for the Zero Downtime Hackathon.

scripts.brightdata:create: bdata scraper create https://news.ycombinator.com "Extract the current top stories as structured records with title, url, points, author, and comment_count"
scripts.port:smoke: npm run port:validate && npm run port:test
scripts.port:release: node scripts/port-workflow.mjs release --run-id local-demo --decision approve --actor local-reviewer
